name: calvino-data-lineage
note: Each step from the organizer's files to the audited tables. The storage location is read from CALVINO_DATA_BUCKET and never written in the repository.

steps.input: organizer dataset, live data/ prefix only (the dated backup is not read)
steps.format: CSV with a UTF-8 byte-order mark; partitioned tables as <table>/year=/month=/day=/*.csv, small tables as <table>.csv

steps.output: data/ (git-ignored), same layout as the source
steps.changes: none: files copied as they are; files of the same size are skipped on reruns
every column read as text with the byte-order mark stripped; for the two largest tables only the columns the analysis needs are kept; no deduplication

steps.script: the analyst's clean_all_tables.py (not yet in the repository; HANDOFF 2.2)
steps.changes: to be recorded from the analyst's delivery; deduplication on primary keys removes 0 rows on the data/ prefix [measured]

steps.input: any of download, analysis-cache or cleaned-layer
steps.output: a JSON report of violation counts per check; aggregates only
steps.changes: none: the audit reads and counts

deliberately_unchanged: null response_code values (about 5% in every status): a known defect, never a failure signal
the unaccented 'Mexico' transaction_country label: merged into México (ISO 3166 MX) only where used, not in storage
claimed_amount in its own currency: converted to USD with daily_exchange_rates only for cross-currency figures
service_agents.assigned_branch_id values missing from branches: reported, not dropped (dropping would delete most agents)
complaints.origin_interaction_id, null on every row: complaints are linked by customer and time
